messages:
mike: Heads-up — planning a low-risk cutover of the pager filter rules at 03:00 UTC tonight. Goal: reduce noise from the transient GPU OOM alerts during nightly batching. Will throttle alerts to paging for alerts with label batch_window="nightly" if rate > 5/min. Leaving p50 latency alerts untouched. Need someone to take primary phone for 03:00–06:00 UTC and be ready to rollback. Also will tweak routing so deduped alerts go to #eng-oncall (no SMS) and escalations still hit pager. TL;DR: filter + routing change. Anyone can swap into primary?

sarah: I can take 03:00–04:30 UTC. Quick Q: what's the rollback plan? Also will this affect oncall in apac?

lee: Rollback: reapply previous alertmanager config and restart amck service. Runbook: /runbooks/pager-filter-cutover — contains commands. APAC unaffected — policy is region-tagged and we only change batch_window matcher for eu/us. Command I'll run (dry-run first):
```bash
kubectl -n monitoring apply -f alertmanager/pager-filter-v2.yaml --dry-run=client
# then:
kubectl -n monitoring apply -f alertmanager/pager-filter-v2.yaml
```

ash: I'll push routing change to disable SMS for deduped batch alerts and keep pager for sev=1. Editing configmap: `pager-routing.rules.v2` — will push and set `routing_version: 2026-03-17-cutover`. Pagerbot will post a config diff in thread.

pagerbot: Config diff uploaded: +route match: {batch_window: nightly, severity: warning} -> notify: #eng-oncall (webhook), sms: false
Escalation still matches severity:critical -> pager.

mike: Thanks @sarah — appreciate cover. @lee please do dry run ~02:50 UTC and ping here with `OK DRY-RUN` before applying. @ash will you tag the commit with `cutover/1795004321` and set a 30-min cooldown for automatic rerouting?

lee: OK DRY-RUN — got a couple noisy test alerts but no pager. Will apply at 03:05 if dry-run clean. One note: batching jobs sometimes have overlapping labels; I added `extra_match: true` in draft to avoid filtering legitimate small jobs.

sarah: If anything noisy slips through, I'll escalate manually to oncall-manager and revert.

ash: Pushed commit `cutover/1795004321` and set cooldown. Applying routing now in 2 mins. I'll also post the revert command in case:
```bash
kubectl -n monitoring apply -f alertmanager/pager-filter-v1.yaml
```

mike: If anything goes wrong, revert + restart `amck` and ping #eng-oncall + phone. I'll be on call as backup 04:30–06:00 UTC.

pagerbot: Deploy started: alertmanager config v2026-03-17-cutover — dry-run status: PASS
Full apply in 60s.

lee: Applied at 03:05 UTC. No pagers so far. Observability note: error rate for batch workers dropped ~12% alert count (monitoring dashboard link).

sarah: :thumbsup: thanks — I'm watching. If we stay stable, I'll follow up with a short postmortem/summary in #eng-oncall tomorrow.

mike: Great. Logging action items:
- lee: confirm dry-run & apply ✅
- ash: commit + cooldown ✅
- sarah: primary coverage til 04:30 ✅
- mike: backup 04:30–06:00 ✅
Leaving thread open for 1h after last message. Thanks team.
